cuts.head: tilt
cuts.placeText: a wood-fired bakery — a brick oven glowing orange, wire racks of loaves, a flour-dusted counter and a stack of baskets
cuts.scene: she is a baker kneeling at the oven mouth, sliding a peel of loaves into the fire
cuts.outfit: a baker look fitted to her body — a short flour-dusted apron over a fitted tank top and short shorts, bare shoulders and legs, an oven mitt tucked in her belt
